# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue for a security vulnerability — report it
privately instead, through either of:

- [GitHub Security Advisories](../../security/advisories/new) (private
  vulnerability reporting)
- <dev@geolid.com>

Include what you'd include in a bug report: where it is, how to reproduce it,
and its impact.

This is a showcase project (not a production service handling real user
data), so there's no formal SLA — expect an initial response within a few
days.
